stem: A six-sided die has faces marked 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. When the die is thrown 300 times it shows a six on 56 throws.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate an approximate 96% confidence interval for the probability that the die shows a six on one throw.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Maroulla claims that the die is biased.

Use your answer to part **(a)** to comment on this claim.
